# Build, generated files and PDF checks

## Fact

- Without `BOOK_LANG=es`, the Spanish layout is not found and the English catalog fails on `lessons/goals.md`. Shell variable prefixes are denied. Set it with a Python wrapper (`os.environ` plus `runpy`, `sys.argv` with `--artifacts-dir`) kept in a scratch directory.
- Check the Spanish builds with `env BOOK_LANG=es python3 lessons/curriculum/build.py --artifacts-dir translation/work/pilot-render/curriculum`. The stock study-guides build refuses a Spanish edition until all 22 guides are Spanish.
- After you translate a file that names phases, run `env BOOK_LANG=es python3 lessons/curriculum/build.py --check` and `verify --fast`.
- Spanish generated files open with `<!-- GENERADO por`, not `GENERATED by`. Use `segment.strip_generated` to compare a file with English or its PO. Never compare generated lines directly.
- Do not commit `build.py --generate` output in Spanish while invariant I13 compares generated blocks with the English source. It fails 19 of 22 `verify --fast` checks. Revert the generated files and record the conflict in `loop/blockers.md` first.
- To re-aim links: `apply.py --relink --write`, then `build.py --generate`, then `anchors.py --generate`.
- When a PDF-010 sentinel fails: extract the page text with PyMuPDF (`fitz`). Copy the approved PO msgstr into `lessons/book/locale/es.yaml`. Run `lint_pdf.py` with `BOOK_LANG=es`. Without it, the English sentinels run against the Spanish PDF.
- Generators: `generate_all` output hashes are the safe proof of a refactor (see `edition-wording-rules.md`).
- Write a new tool test so that it never starts the English repository gates.

## Git index

- If `git add` reports `.git/index.lock: Read-only file system` after the task gates pass, record `partial`, return the task to `todo`, and keep the verified files for the next writable session.
